bio.text: Mike Bost represents Illinois's 12th District in the U.S. House and was sworn into office on January 6, 2015; in the 119th Congress he chairs the Veterans' Affairs Committee.
Before Congress he served two decades in the Illinois House of Representatives, rising to House Republican Caucus Chair, and served as a firefighter with the Murphysboro Fire Department.
He served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 1979 to 1982 and received an honorable discharge as a corporal.
Bost is a lifelong resident of Murphysboro and graduated from Murphysboro High School in 1979.
